area_note: Extremely small, area-optimized core. The core's main state is just the 32-word register file. Adding a 16-word internal buffer in an extension would represent a massive area increase relative to the core size.
constraints: The coprocessor interface (PCPI) cannot access memory. All memory operands must be explicitly loaded into registers by the core.
A custom instruction can accept at most two 32-bit register inputs per invocation.
A custom instruction can return at most one 32-bit register output per invocation.
Large internal buffers and arrays must be avoided; the extension's area footprint must be kept extremely small to match this minimalist core.
coprocessor: Pico Co-Processor Interface (PCPI). Synchronous, stall-based handshake (valid, wait, ready signals).
coprocessor_result: One 32-bit value (pcpi_rd) and a write-enable signal (pcpi_wr).
custom_opcode_space: Any unhandled or illegal opcode is forwarded to PCPI if WITH_PCPI=1.
custom-1 (0x2B), custom-2 (0x5B), custom-3 (0x7B) are completely free.
custom-0 (0x0B) is partially occupied by firmware IRQ handling instructions (getq, setq, maskirq).
evidence: picorv32.v: 'PicoRV32 -- A Small RISC-V (RV32I) Processor Core'
picorv32.v: PCPI ports (pcpi_insn, pcpi_rs1, pcpi_rs2, pcpi_rd) provide exactly two inputs and one output, with no memory address or data ports.
picorv32.v: Core is driven by a multi-cycle state machine (cpu_state_fetch, cpu_state_ld_rs1, cpu_state_exec, cpu_state_ldmem) where instructions take multiple cycles to execute.
picorv32.v: The assign instr_trap logic routes unimplemented instructions to PCPI if WITH_PCPI is enabled.
custom_ops.S: Uses opcode 0b0001011 (custom-0) for getq, setq, retirq, maskirq, waitirq, timer.
existing_units: Multiplier (configurable as multi-cycle shift-add or single-cycle array)
Shifter (configurable as multi-cycle sequential or single-cycle barrel)
isa: RV32I with optional M (Multiply/Divide) and C (Compressed) extensions. Internal IRQ instructions use custom-0.
memory_interface: Native simple valid/ready/wstrb interface, with provided AXI4-Lite and Wishbone adapters.
microarchitecture: Multi-cycle, unpipelined state machine (fetch, decode/register read, execute, memory, writeback).
name: PicoRV32
register_file: 32x32-bit registers. 2 read ports, 1 write port. Can be implemented as dual-port block RAM.
